note: Which buses the weekly job pulls. services = route numbers; nocs = operator codes (Stagecoach Cumbria = SCCU). A service with no manifest places is reported as NEW and left out until its places are added.
floorNote: Fail the run if a service has fewer journeys than this (half the 22 Sep 2026 reference build). Lower a number only after checking the operator timetable.
gapNote: A service below its floor but at or above its gap minimum (default 30% of floor = 15% of the reference size) publishes as a KNOWN GAP (flagged in the app + an issue). Below the gap minimum = the run fails. gapMin overrides the default per service; gapNotes adds a reason shown in the report/issue.

gapNotes.555: Stagecoach's main 555 registration PC0002407/300 is unpublished on BODS (since early Oct 2026); operator emailed 7 Oct.
